full_name: Diana Hernández | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Radcliffe-Salata Climate Justice Fellow Columbia University
bio: Diana Hernández, a Bronx native and tenured associate professor of sociomedical sciences at Columbia University, is a leading expert in energy equity, housing, and health whose debut book, coauthored with Jennifer Laird, documents energy insecurity in America. At Radcliffe, she will focus on a series of papers exploring translational and localized approaches to mitigating energy insecurity, aiming to inform policy and foster community-driven solutions.
